blocks.html: Robinsons Place Manila is going-over-the-top to awaken the season of giving by decking their halls with a fresh and modern twist on Santa’s Christmas Village!

As you enjoy its little retail shops and big international brands, Robinsons Place Manila’s Christmas experience boasts of a 40-ft. Christmas tree with giant bright lit stars and thousands of captivating and twinkling ornaments. Underneath the stunning tree is a perfect insta-worthy display – a secret tunnel filled with sparkling lights that serves as majestic stars and takes flight above your heads, sending positive energy to anyone that enters. You will definitely feel the joys of the Christmas Season as you stand inside the glistening hot air balloon.

Robinsons Malls wants to impart a message of hope and strength to its patrons as you walk through the garden of Christmas trees, giant gift boxes, and shiny hot air balloons. These elements are more than just pretty displays but a reminder to everyone that Christmas will always be a time to connect and establish best memories with your loved ones by seeing the world from up above and spreading happiness beyond clouds of worries and tears.

As Christmas is also the season to give back, Robinsons Place Manila aimed at helping 50 displaced jeepney drivers who were one of the most affected by the coronavirus pandemic. These beneficiaries will each receive special gift baskets and sacks of rice through the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program of Robinsons Malls: The Gift of Change.

The blissful vibe doesn’t stop there as Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) and the City of Manila recently undertook an agreement to construct a covered lighted walkway from Robinsons Place Manila (side of UP PGH) to Pedro Gil LRT station that will benefit an estimate of 60,000 or more pedestrians, protecting them against the sun and other harsh weather conditions.
